package.name: room_nav_bc
package.description: Visuomotor room navigation by imitation learning: a camera+odometry TurtleBot3 learns to navigate around obstacles to a goal, trained from demonstrations generated by a privileged (ground-truth) scripted expert. Companion exercise to parking_bc, covering the same regression-BC / flow-matching / DAgger concepts on a vision-based task where no cheap map is available to the learned policy.
